name: Pollution Control NOC (CTE and CTO)
meta_title: Pollution NOC | Consent to Establish and Operate (CTE/CTO)
meta_description: Get your Consent to Establish and Consent to Operate from the State Pollution Control Board, with category assessment, filing and inspection support.
excerpt: CTE before you build, CTO before you run: both pollution board consents obtained with inspection support.
intro: Factories, workshops, hospitals, hotels and many service units cannot legally set up or operate without consent from the State Pollution Control Board: Consent to Establish (CTE) before construction and Consent to Operate (CTO) before production begins.

Eaccountingcart classifies your unit under the correct category, prepares the application with the technical details boards check and supports you through inspection to consent grant and timely renewals.
what: Under the Water and Air Acts, industries are classified by pollution potential into red, orange, green and white categories, which determine consent requirements, fees and validity. CTE is obtained at the planning stage; CTO follows installation and covers operations, renewable in blocks of years by category. White category units generally need only an intimation, while red category units face the closest scrutiny.
who: Manufacturing units of every size setting up or expanding
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and hotels covered by consent rules
Warehouses, workshops and processing units in orange or green categories
Units whose consents have expired or were never obtained
benefits: Legal to Build and Run
CTE and CTO are prerequisites; running without them risks closure orders.
Correct Category, Fair Fees
Right classification avoids overpaying fees or facing wrong conditions.
Bank and Buyer Compliance
Lenders and large customers verify pollution consents in diligence.
Inspection Preparedness
Site readiness before the board's visit prevents adverse reports.
Renewal Continuity
Consents renewed before expiry keep operations uninterrupted.
documents: Site plan and layout of the unit
Land documents: ownership proof or rent agreement
Manufacturing process flow chart with products and capacity
Details of water consumption and effluent discharge
Details of fuel, boilers and air emission sources
Incorporation and PAN documents of the entity
CA certificate of capital investment
process: Category Assessment
Your activity is mapped to red, orange, green or white with the applicable consents.
Application Preparation
Technical details, process flows and investment certificates are compiled.
Portal Filing
CTE or CTO is filed on the state board's online consent management portal.
Inspection Support
The site is prepared and board queries answered until the report is favourable.
Consent Grant and Renewal
Consent is issued with conditions explained, and renewals tracked in our calendar.
timeline: 30 to 120 days depending on category and state
authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee
validity: 1 to 15 years by category and state policy
fees_note: Fees scale with capital investment and category
why_us: Consent files stall on process descriptions and effluent details written vaguely. Ours are prepared in the board's own vocabulary, which is why they move through scrutiny.
faqs: Does a small workshop really need pollution consent?

It depends on the activity's category, not the size alone. Many small units fall in green or orange categories that need consent, while true white category units only intimate the board. We classify yours definitively first.
What is the difference between CTE and CTO?
CTE permits you to establish the unit, obtained before construction or installation. CTO permits actual operation and is applied for once the unit is ready with pollution control measures installed.
What happens if we have been operating without consent?

Boards can issue closure directions and levy compensation. Voluntary regularisation with a credible compliance plan is usually achievable and always cheaper than enforcement, and we handle those negotiations.
Do consents need renewal?
Yes, CTO is renewed periodically based on category, with applications ideally filed well before expiry. Our reminder calendar keeps client consents continuous.

meta_title: EPR Registration for E-Waste | CPCB Producer Registration
meta_description: Producer, importer or brand owner of electronics? Get CPCB EPR registration for e-waste with target planning and annual return support.
excerpt: CPCB registration and recycling target management for producers and importers of electrical and electronic products.
intro: If you make or import electrical and electronic equipment, the E-Waste Management Rules make you responsible for its end of life. Producers must register on the CPCB's EPR portal, meet yearly recycling targets and file returns, and customs increasingly checks registration at import.

Eaccountingcart registers you on the portal, computes your targets from sales data, arranges EPR certificates from registered recyclers and files the annual returns that keep your registration in good standing.
what: Under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022, producers, importers and brand owners of notified electrical and electronic equipment register with the CPCB and meet extended producer responsibility targets, a rising percentage of the equipment placed on the market in earlier years. Compliance is demonstrated by purchasing EPR certificates generated by registered recyclers, with quarterly and annual returns filed on the portal.
who: Manufacturers of electrical and electronic equipment
Importers of electronics, appliances and IT hardware
Brand owners selling under their own labels
E-commerce brands importing gadgets and accessories
benefits: Customs Clearance Safety
Imports of covered products move smoothly with valid registration.
Marketplace Onboarding
Platforms verify EPR registration for electronics categories.
Target Certainty
Obligations computed correctly from your sales avoid over or under buying certificates.
Penalty Protection
Environmental compensation for non compliance is steep; returns filed on time avoid it.
One Window Management
Registration, certificates and returns handled by one team.

IEC certificate for importers
Product list with EEE codes and quantities placed on market
Sales data for past years as required for target computation

process: Applicability Mapping
Your products are mapped to notified EEE codes and producer categories.
Portal Registration
The CPCB EPR portal application is filed with documents and fees.
Target Computation
Yearly recycling obligations are computed from your market data.
Certificate Procurement
EPR certificates are sourced from registered recyclers to meet targets.
Returns and Renewal

validity: 5 years, subject to returns and target compliance
fees_note: Portal fees scale with turnover; certificate costs depend on targets
why_us: EPR compliance is a numbers game: wrong EEE codes or sales baselines create either penalties or wasted certificate spend. Our computations are documented and defensible.
faqs: We only import small quantities. Does EPR still apply?
Registration applies to producers and importers of notified equipment with limited exemptions. Even small importers face customs checks, so we assess applicability on your exact product codes.
What are EPR certificates and where do they come from?

Registered recyclers generate certificates for quantities they process, which producers purchase on the portal to offset their targets. We manage sourcing at sensible prices from legitimate recyclers.
What happens if targets are missed?
The rules provide environmental compensation charges and registration consequences for shortfalls. Early tracking through the year, which we do quarterly, prevents a year end scramble.
Do resellers and retailers need registration?
Pure resellers of others' brands generally do not, but importers and brand owners do, even if manufacturing is outsourced. The label on the box usually decides, and we confirm your category.

intro: Any business that places plastic packaging on the Indian market, as producer, importer or brand owner, carries recycling obligations under the Plastic Waste Management Rules. Registration on the CPCB portal is mandatory, and marketplaces and enforcement agencies now check it.
Eaccountingcart classifies your packaging by category, registers you on the EPR portal, computes obligations correctly and manages the certificates and annual returns that demonstrate compliance.

why_us: Plastic EPR has four categories, three obligation types and shifting portal rules. We keep client obligations reconciled to invoices, so numbers survive an audit.
faqs: Our brand outsources manufacturing. Who registers?

The brand owner carries EPR obligations for packaging bearing its brand, alongside producers of the packaging itself. Contract structures do not transfer the legal obligation, which is why brand owners register.
What are the four plastic categories?
Category I rigid packaging, Category II flexible, Category III multilayer and Category IV compostable or biodegradable plastics. Each carries separate targets, so classification accuracy drives cost.
Is recycled content mandatory in our packaging?
The rules phase in minimum recycled content percentages for specified categories. We build these into your packaging procurement planning alongside certificate compliance.
What if we missed past years?
The portal computes carry forward obligations, and voluntary regularisation is better than an enforcement notice. We compute honest baselines and negotiate the compliance path.

name: Hazardous Waste Authorization
meta_title: Hazardous Waste Authorization | SPCB Form and Compliance
meta_description: Generate, store or process hazardous waste? Get SPCB authorization with waste categorisation, filing, manifest systems and annual returns.
excerpt: SPCB authorization for hazardous waste generators and processors, with manifests and returns set up properly.
intro: Used oil, spent solvents, chemical sludge, contaminated containers, if your unit generates, stores or handles hazardous waste, you need authorization from the State Pollution Control Board and a documented chain of custody for every kilogram.
Eaccountingcart categorises your waste streams under the rules, obtains the authorization and sets up the manifest and record systems that make inspections and annual returns straightforward.
what: The Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016 require occupiers generating hazardous waste to obtain authorization in the prescribed form from the SPCB, store waste within time limits, dispose only through authorized recyclers or treatment facilities using the manifest system, maintain Form 3 records and file Form 4 annual returns. Authorization is typically valid for five years alongside the unit's CTO.
who: Manufacturing units generating process waste, used oil or solvents
Automobile workshops and service centers
Pharma, chemical and electroplating units
Recyclers and waste handlers seeking authorization

Correct Categorisation

fees_note: State fees vary by waste quantities and category
why_us: Hazardous waste enforcement is record driven. We build the manifest discipline and registers first, so the authorization you get is one you can actually comply with.
faqs: Is used oil from our generators really hazardous waste?
Yes, used and waste oil are scheduled categories requiring authorized handling and disposal through registered recyclers. Even non manufacturing sites with DG sets can be covered.
How long can we store hazardous waste on site?
The rules limit on site storage, generally ninety days with exceptions by permission. Storage beyond limits is a common inspection finding, which disposal scheduling prevents.
What is the manifest system?
A multi copy tracking document that follows each waste consignment from your gate to the disposal facility, with copies returning to you and the board. It is your proof of lawful disposal.
Can we sell waste to any scrap dealer?
No. Scheduled wastes move only to authorized recyclers or treatment facilities. Selling to unauthorized buyers makes you liable for whatever happens downstream.

name: Environmental Clearance
meta_title: Environmental Clearance | EIA and Prior EC for Projects
meta_description: Prior environmental clearance for projects under the EIA notification: screening, EIA coordination, public hearing and appraisal support.
excerpt: Prior environmental clearance managed end to end: screening, EIA studies, public hearing and appraisal.
intro: Large projects, mining, industry, infrastructure, construction above thresholds, need prior environmental clearance before any work begins. The process is technical and staged, and starting work without EC is a violation that haunts projects for years.

Eaccountingcart manages the EC journey with empanelled environmental consultants: screening and scoping, the EIA study, public hearing and appraisal committee presentations, through to the clearance letter and its condition compliance.
what: Under the EIA Notification, 2006, projects are classified as Category A (appraised centrally by the MoEFCC) or Category B (state level SEIAA), with B1 projects requiring a full EIA and public hearing and B2 following simpler appraisal. The process runs from Form 1 and pre feasibility through terms of reference, EIA study, public consultation, appraisal and grant, followed by half yearly compliance reporting on EC conditions.
who: Industrial projects above notified thresholds
Mining, infrastructure and area development projects
Large building and township developments
Expansions and modernisations of existing units
benefits: Project Bankability
Lenders release funds against a valid EC; its absence stalls financing.
Correct Categorisation
A versus B and B1 versus B2 decisions shape cost and timeline dramatically.
Managed Studies
EIA work by accredited consultants scoped tightly to the terms of reference.
Hearing Preparedness
Public consultation managed with genuine community engagement.
Condition Compliance
Post EC monitoring and reporting that keeps the clearance secure.
documents: Project pre feasibility report
Land documents and site plans
Form 1 and proposed terms of reference
Water, power and raw material requirements
Baseline environmental data where available
Incorporation documents of the project proponent
process: Screening and Scoping
Category is determined and terms of reference obtained from the authority.
EIA Study
Accredited consultants conduct baseline studies and impact assessment.
Public Consultation

Appraisal
The expert appraisal committee's questions are answered through presentations.
Grant and Compliance

timeline: 6 to 18 months by category and study seasons
authority: MoEFCC / SEIAA with expert appraisal committees
validity: As per EC terms, typically linked to project life stages
fees_note: Study and processing costs vary widely by project scale
why_us: EC delays come from weak scoping and unprepared hearings. We manage the process like a project, with the technical, legal and community tracks running in parallel.
faqs: How do I know if my project needs EC?
The EIA notification schedules projects by type and threshold, and amendments move the lines. Send us your project parameters and we screen applicability the same week.
What is the difference between Category A and B?
Category A projects are appraised centrally by the MoEFCC; Category B by the state authority, with B2 projects exempt from full EIA and hearing. Categorisation drives your entire timeline.
Can construction start while EC is pending?

No, EC is a prior clearance and starting work is a violation with serious consequences including demolition risk and prosecution. Sequencing the project around the EC timeline is part of our planning.
What happens after EC is granted?
The clearance carries specific conditions with half yearly compliance reports, and authorities monitor them. Condition breaches endanger both the EC and expansions, so we run the compliance calendar.
